items.title: Smarter search
items.desc: One search for songs, artists, lyrics, games, users and settings, with a top result, See all, recent and trending searches. Press Ctrl+K or / on a keyboard.

items.title: Library is now Home
items.desc: Your songs, playlists and the What’s New carousel live on Home, right in the middle of the bottom bar. Profile sits at the far right.

items.title: New bottom bar
items.desc: The bar now reads Icons, Library, Profile, Studios and Games. Settings moved to the gear at the top of the screen.

items.title: Reorder your tabs
items.desc: Open Magic Markup, then Pages, to move tabs up or down or hide the ones you don’t use. Profile always stays.

items.title: Quote widget
items.desc: Add a quote widget in Magic Markup with bars from Treesh songs, then tap shuffle for another one.

artists.title: Icons
artists.sub: A cleaner way to explore artists.

items.title: Icons only
items.desc: Quotes and voice tips now only feature Treesh Icons and their songs.

items.title: Fresh Icon profiles
items.desc: Every Icon has a new layout that puts their best tracks front and center.

items.title: Your uploads stay yours
items.desc: Songs you add show a YOURS tag and never mix in with official Icon tracks.

instrum.title: Instrum Studio
instrum.sub: Beat Maker and Vocals are now one studio.

items.title: One timeline for everything
items.desc: Drum lanes and vocal tracks now sit on the same timeline and play together. Every bar of your beat can be different.

items.title: Record over your beat
items.desc: Press the red button and Treesh records at the playhead while the song plays.

items.title: A real mixer
items.desc: Volume, pan, mute/solo and reverb for every drum lane and vocal track.

items.title: Arrange your song
items.desc: Select bars to duplicate, insert, repeat or delete them. Vocals move with the bars.

items.title: Export the whole song
items.desc: WAV export now includes your vocals, FX and mix. Older beats and takes open right in the new timeline.

items.title: Smoother studio
items.desc: The studio opens with a cleaner motion and tidier controls that fit any screen size.

items.title: Presets, swing and metronome
items.desc: Start from a preset, add groove with swing, keep time with the metronome, then save your beats.

items.title: Don’t Get Caught is live
items.desc: A horror mini-game gauntlet. Mr. Hush only kills what he sees, and The Hollow Bride hunts by sound. Freeze, stay quiet and survive. Ages 13+.

items.title: Arcade filters & search
items.desc: Sort the Arcade by Recently updated, Newly added, Coming soon, age rating, Most played by you or A–Z, or type a game’s name in the search box.

items.title: Notify me
items.desc: Coming-soon games get a Notify me button, and Treesh tells you when they go live.

items.title: Bronze Blitz is live
items.desc: A match-3 that celebrates the culture. Swap vinyl, crowns, kicks and djembes across 30 levels and 5 modes, from Timed Blitz to Endless Zen. Rated for all ages.

items.title: Sonoko is live
items.desc: Sudoku logic meets card-game chaos. Match color or number, drop each card in its correct cell and call SONOKO! on your last one. Ages 6+.

items.title: Ebonics is live
items.desc: Decode AAVE, finish iconic phrases, call Real or Cap and flip phrases with an AI judge. 7 modes and a 50-term Lexicon. Ages 13+.

items.title: Eco mode
items.desc: Same Treesh look with lighter work. Floating 3D art holds still and heavy effects pause, so older phones stay smooth. It can turn on by itself on older phones.

items.title: Meet Urias
items.desc: Your voice assistant has a name. Say “Hey Urias” before a command, or rename it in Settings, Voice. Tips stay tucked behind the tip button.

items.title: Pull to refresh
items.desc: On your phone, pull down at the top of a page to reload Treesh. You can turn it off in Settings.

items.title: Font and color together
items.desc: Your typeface and text color now live in one card under Appearance.

items.title: A clean sign out
items.desc: Signing out clears your profile, settings, playlists, favorites and stats from this device. Your own music stays put.

items.title: Confirm your email in style
items.desc: New accounts get a Treesh confirmation page that signs you right in.

items.title: Delete your account
items.desc: Remove your Treesh account and cloud backup any time from Settings, Account.

items.title: Lyric themes
items.desc: Tap the swatch next to the lyrics: Text Messages, Karaoke Neon, Typewriter, Notebook, Retro Terminal, Comic Bubbles or Polaroid Story. Pin a theme to one song if you like.

items.title: Lyrics as a group chat
items.desc: Text Messages turns each line into a text bubble from the artist, with typing dots and read receipts. They’re lyrics, not real messages.

items.title: Singer colors are optional
items.desc: Lines on songs with more than one artist now use one color by default. Turn on Color lines by singer in the Lyric theme sheet.

items.title: Themed lyric cards
items.desc: Lyric cards can use any lyric theme as their style.

items.title: Swipe the mini player away
items.desc: Swipe the mini player down to close it. It stays closed the next time you open Treesh, until you play something.

items.title: Restyle the mini player
items.desc: In Magic Markup, pick a glass, solid or accent look, choose which controls show and move it to the top, bottom or sides.

items.title: Flick to close
items.desc: Flick Now Playing down from anywhere and it closes right away.

lyricstudio.title: Lyric Studio
lyricstudio.sub: Time your lyrics like a pro.

items.title: Desktop studio layout
items.desc: On big screens the player sits in the left column while you write or sync, and the preview looks exactly like Now Playing.

items.title: Write and sync
items.desc: Type or paste your lyrics, then tap the space bar to time each line while the track plays.

items.title: Word by word timing
items.desc: Open Word timing on any line to set the exact moment each word is sung.
